job_role: BESS BMS Research and Development Engineer
description:
The Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) Battery Management Systems (BMS) Research and Development (R&D) Engineer focuses on the research and development of innovative solutions that improve the performance of BESS BMS and its components. He/She defines research objectives and parameters, designs and executes experiments, and analyses data to identify ways to improve the performance of BESS, while developing innovative technologies in energy management and integration. He processes technical understanding of BESS and cross-functional expertise to successfully manage end-to-end work areas in battery management systems projects, 

The BESS BMS R&D Engineer should possess critical thinking, creativity, and data literacy skills to solve complex problems, with strong collaboration skills to work across teams.

cwf.critical_work_function: Analyse experimental data for battery management systems
key_tasks: Utilise artificial intelligence and/or machine learning (AI/ML) algorithms to analyse sensor data and optimise battery management system control logic to balance efficiency, battery life and safety
Evaluate system responses to identify anomalies in battery management system functions and develop solutions to improve the accuracy of battery health, safety and life-cycle management
Analyse thermal data collected during experiments to refine cooling system efficiency and ensure proper heat dissipation and consistent temperature control
Document improvements in state estimation algorithms and detailing data-driven optimisations that contribute to reliable state-of-charge (SOC) and state-of-health (SOH) tracking methodologies
Recommend system adjustments to improve fault detection by utilising predictive analytics to mitigate potential issues before they affect battery performance

cwf.critical_work_function: Define research objectives, priorities and parameters for battery management systems
key_tasks: Define research targets to improve safety, operational performance, and life-cycle management through monitoring and predictive maintenance technologies
Establish parameters for integrating battery management systems with BESS components, including power electronics, energy management systems, and sensor data collection units
Identify artificial intelligence-based (AI) methodologies relevant for enhancing state-of-charge (SOC) and state-of-health (SOH) estimations to ensure more accurate energy management predictions
Collaborate with mechanical and electrochemical teams to create integrated objectives that address battery management system needs related to thermal stability and electrochemical balance

Set battery management system optimisation objectives to maximise Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) efficiency, with focus on real-time data processing, safety protocols and battery packs life-cycle enhancement

cwf.critical_work_function: Design and execute experiments for battery management systems
key_tasks: Develop battery management system control algorithms to optimise real-time battery status monitoring with a focus on current, voltage, and thermal sensors for precise state estimation
Implement hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing setups to validate battery management system performance under diverse operational conditions to ensure robustness in real-world scenarios
Test battery management system integration with mechanical, thermal, and electrochemical components to achieve optimal coordination between hardware elements and software algorithms

Create predictive artificial intelligence (AI) models that simulate battery management system responses under various scenarios with a focus on anomaly detection, state prediction, and failure prevention
Use simulations to evaluate the impact of varying load conditions on battery management system operations to determine maximum efficiency in battery resources management

cwf.critical_work_function: Develop prototypes and solutions for battery management systems
key_tasks: Verify that battery management system prototypes conform to regulatory safety standards for battery control systems to address requirements for high-voltage operations
Conduct validation tests to ensure compliance with industry standards for electronic safety and data integrity in battery management
Develop prototypes for next-generation battery management systems that dynamically adapt to changing operational conditions by enhancing safety and efficiency through innovative solutions
Prototype hardware-software integration for enhanced battery management system safety features, focusing on real-time data collection, fault detection, and autonomous corrective actions
Implement programming-based simulation models to enhance failure prediction accuracy and refine decision-making processes for energy management and protection systems
Validate the effectiveness of new control algorithms through comprehensive testing under simulated and real-world conditions with a focus on performance and safety metrics

Test battery management system prototypes for battery energy storage systems (BESS) by ensuring compatibility and robustness while addressing unique challenges related to increased power density and thermal management

cwf.critical_work_function: Manage battery energy storage systems (BESS) research documentation
key_tasks: Work closely with software developers to enhance algorithmic precision to ensure seamless integration of new features and improved battery state estimations
Document hardware-software integration protocols for clarity and repeatability to aid future development and scaling efforts in battery management system engineering
Share battery management system technology advancements with technical and industry stakeholders to provide insights into system improvements, efficiency gains and safety enhancements
Collaborate on cross-functional projects involving electrochemistry and mechanical teams to ensure that the battery management systems (BMS) are effectively integrated with all BESS components
Prepare technical documentation and compliance reports to support regulatory filings to ensure all new battery management system developments meet industry safety and performance standards

Develop patentable battery management algorithms and control systems that enhance safety and efficiency while contributing to the patent development process for innovative safety protocols and data processing techniques

job_role: BESS Electrochemistry Research and Development Engineer
description:
The Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) Electrochemistry Research and Development (R&D) Engineer focuses on the research and development of innovative solutions that improve the performance of BESS and its components. He/She defines research objectives and parameters, designs and executes experiments, and analyses data to identify ways to improve the performance of battery in BESS, while developing innovative technologies in energy management and integration. He processes technical understanding of BESS and cross-functional expertise to works across the various area of battery management systems to successfully manage BESS R&D projects from end-to-end. 

The BESS Electrochemistry R&D Engineer possess critical thinking, creativity and data literacy skills to solve complex problems, with strong collaboration skills to work across teams.

cwf.critical_work_function: Analyse experimental data for battery energy storage systems (BESS)
key_tasks: Interpret data from electrochemical impedance spectroscopy and voltage-current curves to determine material performance, ionic conductivity, and charge-transfer efficiency in energy storage systems
Use AI/ML models to predict battery degradation under different charge-discharge conditions and suggest mitigation strategies to prolong battery life and reliability in battery energy storage systems
Analyse trends in material stability and provide specific recommendations for composition adjustments to improve performance, capacity retention and thermal stability in BESS
Evaluate reaction kinetics using experimental data to improve the rate of charge and discharge to, optimise fast charging capabilities while maintaining cell safety in BESS
Apply mathematical modelling techniques to identify and predict potential failure modes, ensure early intervention strategies to enhance safety and performance of battery energy storage systems

cwf.critical_work_function: Define research objectives, priorities and parameters on electrochemistry for battery energy storage systems (BESS)
key_tasks: Identify electrochemical performance goals for enhanced BESS solutions, related to capacity, efficiency and safety in line with industry benchmarks and technical standards
Set research priorities aimed at improving battery performance through optimising electrochemical reactions, material stability and minimise degradation pathways
Define critical parameters for electrochemical reaction analysis including ion conductivity, charge transfer resistance and thermal stability in line with project scopes
Align research objectives with industry standards and ensure adherence to safety, efficiency and sustainability requirements

Integrate artificial intelligence (AI) and/or machine learning (ML) algorithms to identify key factors influencing cell efficiency and set data-driven objectives to improve charge-discharge cycles and operational lifespan

cwf.critical_work_function: Design and execute experiments for battery energy storage systems (BESS)
key_tasks: Incorporate material science methodologies to identify structural changes that affect electrochemical behaviour to enhance battery material selection and design in energy storage systems
Develop cell prototypes to examine electrolyte and electrode interactions and ensure materials are tested for energy density, stability and compatibility under real conditions
Design experimental protocols to assess material stability, degradation rates and electrochemical kinetics of BESS using controlled laboratory simulations and real-world scenarios
Implement AI-based experimental models to predict charge-discharge efficiency and identify optimal operation ranges for improved energy density and cycle stability
Set up safe and reliable test station for the electrochemical and thermal testing for cells
Execute testing to monitor thermal behaviour during electrochemical cycles with the focus on mitigating risks of thermal runaway and ensure consistent cell performance in energy storage systems

cwf.critical_work_function: Develop prototypes and solutions for battery energy storage systems (BESS)
key_tasks: Modify electrolyte composition to enhance ionic conductivity and thermal stability, address identified performance bottlenecks through systematic prototyping of BESS
Prototype cells using optimised electrode and electrolyte materials with the focus on enhancing energy density, reducing resistance and ensure consistent output efficiency for ESS
Integrate AI-based predictions and modelling techniques to refine electrochemical processes, enhance BESS response and reduce risks associated with material failures
Develop alternative battery chemistries aimed at boosting energy density, operational safety and thermal efficiency of BESS
Test new materials for enhanced compatibility with mechanical structures and cooling systems to ensure overall integration into BESS without compromising performance
Ensure BESS prototypes meet regulatory standards for electrochemical materials BESS safety, environmental impact and energy efficiency compliance
Document compliance measures for electrolyte and electrode testing and align prototypes with relevant international and regional standards

cwf.critical_work_function: Manage research documentation for battery energy storage systems (BESS)
key_tasks: Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to optimise electrode formulations and balance electrochemical properties for enhanced charge capacity and BESS durability
Document detailed electrochemical methodologies, data collection techniques and analysis protocols to maintain transparency and repeatability in research processes
Present findings to cross-functional stakeholders focusing on practical implications for BESS improvements
Share data-driven insights to support system-level optimisation to enhance battery life prediction and improve overall energy management efficiency
Identify novel electrochemical formulations or processes that can be patented and contribute to drafting patent documentation
Collaborate with legal and research and development teams to protect intellectual property related to electrolyte and electrode innovations

job_role: BESS Mechanical and Material Research and Development Engineer
description:
The Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) Mechanical and Material Research and Development (R&D) Engineer focuses on the research and development of innovative solutions that improve the performance of BESS and its components. He/She defines research objectives and parameters, designs and executes experiments, and analyses data to identify ways to improve the performance of BESS, while developing innovative technologies in energy management and integration. He processes technical understanding of BESS and cross-functional expertise to work across the specific areas in mechanical and materials and manage end-to-end projects.

The BESS Mechanical and Material R&D Engineer should possess critical thinking, creativity, and data literacy skills to solve complex problems, with strong collaboration skills to work across teams.

cwf.critical_work_function: Analyse experimental data for energy storage systems
key_tasks: Apply machine learning techniques to analyse mechanical stress and strain results to derive insights that can be applied to improve structural robustness
Use appropriate programming languages to evaluate material fatigue to predict potential failure points and suggest reinforcements to increase lifespan and performance
Assess the efficiency of thermal management systems using experimental data and refine material choices to improve cooling capabilities and reduce hot spots
Document findings on material strength, resilience, and thermal resistance with data to inform decisions on enhancing structural components efficiency
Generate actionable insights to improve battery management systems (BMS) predictions on cell failures by providing data on mechanical stresses that affect battery health over time

cwf.critical_work_function: Define research objectives, priorities and parameters for mechanical and material requirements for battery energy storage systems (BESS)
key_tasks: Determine mechanical and material requirements to ensure BESS module stability, including structural integrity, weight optimisation and thermal management goals
Set research objectives to improve material selection for thermal management, energy efficiency and resilience to mechanical and environmental stressors
Define material optimisation goals based on electrochemical properties to ensure selected materials contribute positively to battery capacity and lifespan
Establish predictive cell failure analysis objectives with appropriate programming languages, focusing on identifying failure causes and to improve the overall battery management accuracy
Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to align mechanical objectives with energy storage needs with focus on integration and system reliability

cwf.critical_work_function: Design and execute experiments on materials in energy storage systems
key_tasks: Develop experiments to assess material durability under mechanical and thermal stress to determine long-term reliability
Utilise computer programming models to predict material and structural failures by applying these insights to enhance the design and safety features of BESS components
Conduct thermal management experiments to optimise cooling pathways and evaluate the effectiveness of current and alternative thermal dissipation solutions
Perform material testing processes on various materials to evaluate their structural resilience and determine suitable materials for battery energy storage systems (BESS) deployment
Utilise artificial intelligence-driven simulations to predict and optimise mechanical component designs to aim to reduce weight, increased durability and better heat management

cwf.critical_work_function: Develop structural and mechanical prototypes and solutions for energy storage systems
key_tasks: Prototype structural elements using optimised materials with the focus on load distribution, resilience to environmental factors and enhanced cooling capabilities
Develop advanced thermal management systems using data-driven approaches and incorporating material innovations to reduce operational temperature fluctuations
Use appropriate programming languages to refine models to predict and mitigate potential failure points and integrate these models with BMS for improved real-time diagnostics
Create mock-ups to test the manufacturability and feasibility of new mechanical designs with the focus on meeting design requirements while reducing production costs
Incorporate novel materials that improve mechanical stability and contribute to the overall electrochemical efficiency of the battery cells
Assess and document prototype structural elements to ensure compliance with mechanical safety and resilience standards including thermal management requirements
Conduct compliance testing on new materials for environmental and safety regulations to ensure integration of battery energy storage systems (BESS) aligns with international guidelines
Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to ensure data integration for predictive models that contribute to enhance mechanical and material properties and reduced failure rates
Document research methodologies, experimental setups and results to provide a clear reference for future mechanical and materials research projects
Present advancements in mechanical design and materials optimisation to cross-functional teams with the focus on battery energy storage systems (BESS) efficiency, stability, and long-term performance
Share data-driven insights with electrochemistry team to ensure materials are optimised for both structural integrity and electrochemical efficiency
Provide comprehensive documentation for regulatory compliance, including materials testing, stress analysis and safety assessment reports
Assist in developing patent applications for new materials or structural designs that enhance BESS module stability and thermal management
Document unique mechanical innovations for intellectual property protection with the focus on advanced materials or methods for reducing system weight while improving resilience

job_role: BESS Quality Assurance and Certification Engineer
description:
The Battery and Energy Storage Systems (BESS) Quality Assurance and Certification Engineer develops and implements quality assurance processes for battery and energy storage systems, ensuring they comply with regulatory and industry standards. He/she conducts compliance testing, manages certification processes, performs inspections for safety and reliability, and collaborates with cross-functional teams to address quality issues and drive continuous improvement. Additionally, he oversees documentation and making regular reports to ensure full compliance with relevant standards and certifications.

The role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to adapt to evolving technologies and regulations. Effective communication and collaboration are crucial for working with internal teams and external certification organisations, ensuring all systems meet required quality and safety benchmarks.

cwf.critical_work_function: Conduct quality and risk assessments for battery and energy storage systems (BESS)
key_tasks: Evaluate BESS materials and components for thermal performance and internal resistance to ensure alignment with product safety and reliability standards
Conduct routine quality inspections at key production stages to ensure BESS components adhere to defined quality and regulatory specifications
Inspect raw materials used for BESS to ensure all materials quality meet required specifications before entering the production process
Monitor production lines for defects or deviations and address issues of non-conformity to ensure integrity of component and systems
Report non-conformities identified during inspections and document resolution activities to prevent recurrence in future production cycles
Maintain accurate and comprehensive records of all inspections with data to identify trends and areas for quality improvements
Conduct risk assessments for BESS with emphasis on the safety aspects of battery technologies

cwf.critical_work_function: Develop quality assurance processes for battery and energy storage systems (BESS)
key_tasks: Update and optimise quality assurance processes for BESS regularly to reflect new technologies, manufacturing techniques and changes in regulatory and/or safety requirements
Develop quality management tools to proactively address potential quality issues in the BESS production process
Define safety protocols to prevent risks to battery and energy storage systems to ensure alignment with industry safety standards

Collaborate with engineering and production teams as well as external stakeholders to integrate quality benchmarks and inspection protocols at key stages of the component and systems development lifecycle
Define inspection criteria and test protocols to ensure consistent quality from the initial design to the final stages of manufacturing
Develop quality assurance processes to evaluate BESS components during design and production stages to ensure compliance with internal and external regulatory standards

cwf.critical_work_function: Manage product certification and documentation for battery and energy storage systems (BESS)
key_tasks: Plan and coordinate BESS component and system-level tests to ensure full compliance with relevant certifications and standards through third-party laboratories
Ensure that BESS meet grid compliance requirements through liaison with relevant authorities to certify the system against grid integration standards
Prepare and submit comprehensive technical documentation and compliance data for BESS to certification agencies for review and approval
Monitor and lead periodic re-certification efforts for BESS and update certifications in accordance with evolving standards and regulatory requirements

cwf.critical_work_function: Perform compliance testing for battery and energy storage systems (BESS)
key_tasks: Coordinate with internal and/or third-party laboratories to schedule and conduct required compliance and certification testing for BESS
Conduct internal pre-certification tests to identify and resolve potential non-compliance issues with BESS prior to formal certification submission
Analyse testing data to validate the performance, durability and safety of BESS components to ensure that outcomes are aligned with certification requirements
Document test data through detailed reports to ensure that compliance and certification processes are followed and archived in accordance with regulatory standards
Develop and execute test protocols to verify that BESS meet industry standards and requirements to ensure regulatory compliance and safety

cwf.critical_work_function: Support battery and energy storage systems (BESS) quality improvements
key_tasks: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather feedback on system upgrades and incorporate insights from production, engineering and end-users to guide future technological improvements
Evaluate supplier quality management systems to ensure alignment with organisational quality standards and regulatory requirements
Identify areas for quality improvement through analysis of inspection data to implement corrective actions and enhance quality of BESS
Conduct training for quality assurance and production teams on updated quality protocols for BESS, new inspection techniques and best practices to ensure compliance with standards
Lead continuous improvement initiatives to optimise the reliability, safety, and regulatory compliance of BESS by incorporating industry best practices
Analyse key performance metrics for BESS to assess the effectiveness of quality improvement initiatives and training, and refine processes as necessary
Collaborate with suppliers to address quality issues and implement corrective actions and drive continuous improvement in supplied components

description:
The Battery and Energy Storage Systems (BESS) Test and Commissioning Engineer is responsible for conducting system testing, overseeing commissioning activities, and ensuring operational readiness of battery and energy storage systems and compatibility with grid and related systems. He/she performs equipment testing, troubleshooting, manages site and factory acceptance testing, monitors power quality, and ensures adherence to technical specifications.

The BESS Test and Commissioning Engineer possesses strong collaboration, communication, and problem-solving skills to coordinate with cross-functional teams and troubleshoot effectively. He also requires adaptability and technical proficiency to respond to system issues and optimise performance during commissioning.

cwf.critical_work_function: Conduct battery and energy storage systems (BESS) test planning and execution
key_tasks: Plan and execute end-to-end test procedures, including performance and functionality checks, to validate newly installed BESS against technical specifications
Perform pre-commissioning functional and operational tests to ensure proper operation of subsystems, control systems and safety interlocks of BESS
Verify BESS performance under various operating conditions and ensure alignment with energy storage capacity and discharge parameters
Utilise specialised testing equipment to monitor BESS outputs and performance metrics
Identify and rectify faults, non-conformities, or performance deviations discovered during test phases to ensure issues are addressed prior to commissioning of BESS
Document all test results, create reports for external and internal review and future reference during maintenance cycles for BESS

cwf.critical_work_function: Ensure safe operational readiness of battery and energy storage systems (BESS)
key_tasks: Review operational procedures and work instructions for BESS to ensure compliance with safety regulations and protocols
Implement and monitor safety protocols during live testing and commissioning of BESS
Conduct risk assessments for BESS, identify potential safety hazards during commissioning and implement mitigation measures
Oversee the safe energisation and de-energisation of BESS components and ensure adherence to all safety procedures and protocols to avoid incidents
Coordinate with safety engineers and other stakeholders to identify and mitigate risks associated with BESS to ensure a safe environment during system energisation and testing
Ensure compliance with local, international and industry safety standards for commissioning activities

cwf.critical_work_function: Oversee commissioning activities for battery and energy storage systems (BESS)
key_tasks: Prepare for BESS commissioning, ensure readiness for safe operation and perform final integration and functional checks
Perform BESS configuration checks, verify proper calibration, control setpoints and communication protocols between components
Verify integration of BESS components to ensure seamless operational interfaces
Collaborate with installation teams to troubleshoot and resolve commissioning issues with BESS including mismatches with hardware and software and communication errors
Review and validate all commissioning reports for BESS and ensure alignment with operational and safety standards before handing over to operations teams
Validate BESS compatibility with the grid or other systems to ensure smooth energy transfer and response to signals in real-time

cwf.critical_work_function: Perform system diagnostics and troubleshooting for battery and energy storage systems (BESS)
key_tasks: Analyse system logs, alarms, and operational data to identify recurring faults or performance issues with BESS and provide corrective actions as necessary
Diagnose system malfunctions or performance issues for BESS using advanced diagnostic tools
Utilise software diagnostic tools and Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) systems to troubleshoot and resolve faults in BESS components
Update system configurations and control setpoints after troubleshooting to optimise BESS performance and prevent future operational issues
Document all troubleshooting activities, corrective actions and configuration changes for BESS
Maintain and update troubleshooting documentation as reference for future BESS upgrades

cwf.critical_work_function: Provide technical support and training to cross-functional teams on battery and energy storage systems (BESS)
key_tasks: Train end-users, operational and maintenance teams on system functionalities, troubleshooting techniques, battery-specific modules and optimisation post-commissioning of BESS
Provide real-time technical support to the operations team during the initial stages of BESS operations and address any system queries or concerns
Assist clients and stakeholders by providing technical support and clarifying BESS operation and maintenance requirements during project handover
Conduct post-commissioning reviews to assess BESS performance, provide recommendations for enhancements or corrective measures
Provide feedback to design and engineering teams based on operational data and testing results to suggest improvements for future BESS projects

description:
The Solar Photovoltaic (PV) Asset Performance Engineer is responsible for ensuring the long-term reliability and efficiency of solar pv assets by managing life-cycle and performance optimisation. He/She monitors system performance, analyses data to identify improvements, collaborates with operations and maintenance teams to resolve faults, and implements strategies to enhance energy production and system efficiency. He also oversees system upgrades and troubleshooting to maintain sustained performance improvement, while ensuring compliance with regulatory and safety standards.

The Solar PV Asset Performance Engineer requires strong project management skills to oversee system upgrades and coordinate maintenance. Effective stakeholder engagement is also important for collaborating with cross-functional teams, external contractors, and regulatory bodies.

cwf.critical_work_function: Diagnose and resolve solar photovoltaic (PV) system issues
key_tasks: Investigate solar PV system faults through remote diagnostic software, site visits and physical inspections and pinpoint root cause of underperformance
Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, software issues affecting solar PV system outputs and work to minimise downtime and financial losses
Collaborate with operations and maintenance (O&M) teams to provide technical guidance for real-time operational issues with solar PV systems to ensure swift issue resolutions
Coordinate repairs and/or upgrades for solar PV systems with external contractors and/or maintenance teams to ensure timely restoration of asset functionality
Document all identified issues, repairs and resolutions for solar PV systems and maintain detailed logs for future analysis and improved troubleshooting

cwf.critical_work_function: Manage compliance of solar photovoltaic (PV) assets with safety and regulatory standards
key_tasks: Ensure that all components of solar PV assets meet local and international safety and compliance standards
Conduct routine safety and compliance inspections on electrical and mechanical installations for solar PV assets to identify and mitigate risks
Stay abreast of regulatory and industry best practices to ensure that solar PV assets comply with evolving safety, environmental and operational standards
Coordinate with regulatory authorities for solar PV system inspections, certifications, and audits to ensure that necessary approvals and licenses are maintained
Maintain detailed records of compliance activities, inspections and corrective actions to ensure preparedness for regulatory audits of solar PV assets
Track energy output and operational parameters of solar PV systems using advanced monitoring tools to ensure optimal performance and efficiency
Analyse real-time performance data for solar PV systems and comparing against simulations and benchmarks to detect deviations and prevent system underperformance
Identify performance issues with solar PV assets by reviewing historical and live data trends
Generate detailed performance reports and dashboards for solar PV systems, summarise energy production, efficiency and identified issues
Maintain the monitoring platform and address any system issues to ensure seamless and accurate data collection for performance analysis

cwf.critical_work_function: Optimise energy production and solar photovoltaic (PV) asset efficiency
key_tasks: Monitor the impact of implemented changes to solar PV assets and verify improvements in performance and identify areas for further optimisation
Provide detailed recommendations to stakeholders on potential system upgrades or retrofits for solar PV systems that could enhance long-term asset performance
Conduct performance assessments to identify opportunities for improving solar PV asset efficiency and output through system adjustments or enhancements
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to evaluate the impact of solar PV module technology, system design and balance of system (BoS) on overall asset performance
Implement optimisation strategies to improve the energy yield of solar PV assets

cwf.critical_work_function: Support solar photovoltaic (PV) system upgrades and technological improvements
key_tasks: Evaluate the performance of existing solar PV assets and propose potential upgrades or modifications to enhance energy production and efficiency
Research emerging solar technologies and innovations that could improve solar PV asset performance and integrate them into current systems where appropriate
Work closely with engineering teams to design and implement solar PV system enhancements
Assist in testing and integrating new solar technologies into existing PV assets to ensure compatibility and evaluate their impact on energy output
Collaborate with vendors and contractors for the installation and commissioning of new equipment related to solar PV assets to ensure compliance with performance and safety standards

description:
The High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) Operations and Maintenance Specialist is responsible for ensuring the reliability, safety, and efficiency of HVDC systems. He/She monitors, troubleshoots, and maintains HVDC systems and equipment through regular visual inspections, testing and calibration. He tracks critical performance metrics, develops predictive maintenance schedules to anticipate faults and implements ways to optimise HVDC systems. 

He requires problem solving, sense-making and decision-making skills to monitor HVDC systems and engage in troubleshooting of issues. He adapts to challenges that arise during operations and maintenance and collaborate effectively with other stakeholders to ensure the safety and compliance of HVDC systems.

cwf.critical_work_function: Implement preventative maintenance and support corrective upgrades and modifications of High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) systems
key_tasks: Support implementation of HVDC system upgrades and modifications to improve performance and reliability
Commission new HVDC equipment and ensure seamless integration into existing systems by compatibility validation, functional test and updating operational protocols
Plan and manage maintenance of HVDC system in accordance with Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) maintenance regime
Develop preventative maintenance schedules based on data-driven insights and predictive analytics to ensure the reliability and longevity of HVDC systems
Analyse reliability data to identify patterns and recurring issues in components of HVDC systems to determine the causes of reduced reliability
Perform routine inspections of HVDC systems and equipment to assess condition and confirm if upgrades and repairs are required
Perform maintenance of HVDC systems using condition-based monitoring systems that utilise real-time sensor data to proactively address early signs of wear or impending faults

cwf.critical_work_function: Manage safety and compliance of High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) operation and maintenance activities
key_tasks: Update HVDC operational documentation to reflect changes in regulatory requirements, operational and maintenance practices
Oversee quality assurance processes to verify documentation pertaining to system operation and maintenance for accuracy, completeness and compliance
Review and update reliability standards for HVDC systems to ensure alignment with industry best practices and current system demands
Document safety procedures and protocols for operating and maintaining HVDC systems and include emergency response plans
Ensure HVDC systems comply with safety and environmental regulations, document impact assessment outcomes and mitigation measures
Conduct regular reviews of safety and regulatory compliance during operations and maintenance activities

cwf.critical_work_function: Optimise High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) system performance
key_tasks: Monitor optimisation changes to assess their impact on performance metrics, efficiency, stability and fault rates of HVDC systems
Collaborate with stakeholders to integrate new optimisation tools, methodologies and systems into HVDC infrastructures
Analyse load distribution, energy usage and demand times to identify trends and opportunities to optimise HVDC system performance
Conduct test for different operational scenarios and predict system behaviour under varying conditions to inform HVDC system improvement
Collaborate with stakeholders to develop optimisation strategies to improve system efficiency under various load conditions

cwf.critical_work_function: Oversee operations and monitoring of High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) systems
key_tasks: Identify and respond to operational faults or system alarms and analyse system data to diagnose and isolate faults with HVDC equipment or systems
Monitor performance metrics, power output stability, and fault frequency to assess system health, load balance, efficiency energy throughput and identify areas for improvement
Oversee real-time operations of HVDC systems to ensure efficient and reliable power transmission to achieve maximum availability for import projects
Support incident response and management during planned outages by coordinating operations, troubleshooting issues and ensure continuity of HVDC system performance
Utilise control systems to operate HVDC equipment to ensure adjustments to system settings are deployed in response to system conditions, load changes or grid demands
Develop emergency protocols to handle faults and system disruptions and contingencies during planned and unplanned outages within HVDC system
Test and calibrate HVDC systems and equipment periodically to ensure accurate voltage and power flow through the systems
Integrate automated monitoring systems that track system performance metrics and detect deviations or anomalies in voltage levels, current values and power quality

cwf.critical_work_function: Troubleshoot and resolve High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) system faults
key_tasks: Diagnose and identify the root cause of HVDC system faults
Implement temporary bypass or redundancy solutions during critical component failures to minimise disruption to overall operations
Document fault diagnoses, initial symptoms, testing, tools and the resolution processes for HVDC system faults
Conduct validation tests to ensure the proper operations of HVDC systems and ensure all operational parameters are within acceptable limits
Engage in post-incident reviews to evaluate efficacy of troubleshooting efforts and suggest improvements for future fault investigations
Deploy troubleshooting protocols to adjust, repair or make replacements within HVDC systems

description:
The High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) System Integration Engineer is responsible for designing, planning and implementing the seamless integration of HVDC systems within existing and/or new power grids. He/She evaluates and optimises HVDC components and interconnectivities with the grid to ensure compatibility, efficiency and stability in power transmission. He also manages system requirements, regulatory compliance and execution for HVDC system integration projects.

He stays up-to-date with emerging technologies to determine suitability and opportunities to integrate within existing HVDC systems. Sense-making, decision-making and communication skills are critical for performing in this role.

cwf.critical_work_function: Conduct High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) system and component testing and troubleshooting prior to handover
key_tasks: Conduct HVDC component testing to ensure efficiency and performance meet design specifications
Perform integrated system testing under normal and fault conditions to ensure cohesive functioning of HVDC systems and components
Perform control testing on system communication links and safety protocols to ensure smooth operation and emergency response processes
Perform Site Acceptance Testing (SAT) of HVDC systems to validate functionality and performance
Analyse performance metrics data to identify deviations from expected performance, stability and efficiency of HVDC systems
Conduct quality assurance checks and visual inspections on HVDC components to ensure adherence to design specifications and installation requirements for grid integration
Develop recommendations for system upgrades and maintenance for integrated HVDC systems, based on design specifications and desired system performance

cwf.critical_work_function: Define technical requirements and design layouts of High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) systems to optimise system performance
key_tasks: Evaluate modelling and simulation data to identify modifications required to HVDC system designs and components
Develop HVDC system implementation plans, outlining required equipment and maintenance requirements to ensure performance and longevity of HVDC systems
Assess environmental and geographical characteristics of integration sites to determine requirements relating to HVDC systems and components
Define technical specifications for HVDC systems by considering factors influencing power flow, environmental operating conditions and existing grids
Oversee the selection of HVDC system equipment by considering efficiency, cost and compatibility with desired grid systems
Design and plan the layout of HVDC systems to ensure accurate placement of components to optimise performance, efficiency and space utilisation
Use software to model and simulate HVDC system networks to predict system behaviour under different operating conditions and environmental influences

cwf.critical_work_function: Design and establish control systems and protection protocols for the integration of High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) systems with existing power grids
key_tasks: Review national and international grid codes to ensure HVDC system designs meet prevailing voltage and frequency regulations as well as Transmission Codes and local regulations
Design control systems to maintain stable and continuous power transfer between HVDC systems and grids to minimise fluctuations and ensure balance under varying load and grid conditions
Develop protection schemes to safeguard HVDC components, identify faults and initiate system shutdown or isolation procedures
Design communication systems for real-time data exchange between HVDC system components and grid operators to facilitate the monitoring of system operations during integration
Establish interconnection points between HVDC systems and the grid by identifying key locations for stations, substations and protective devises
Integrate HVDC systems with existing Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) and Energy Management Systems (EMS) to enable real-time control and decision-making in system operations
Ensure seamless operations between HVDC systems with the power grid through effective management of load sharing

cwf.critical_work_function: Implement safety protocols and manage documentation in line with requirements related to High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) system integration
key_tasks: Develop emergency response protocols and integrate within control and protection systems
Create technical documentation covering the design, integration, testing and commissioning of HVDC systems
Develop operational manuals for HVDC components and system designs, outlining system functionality, safety protocols and troubleshooting procedures
Ensure maintenance of technical documentation to cover system updates, changes and modifications in alignment with industry and regulatory requirements
Engage with grid operators and maintenance teams on system design and integration requirements to facilitate the smooth operation and management of HVDC systems
Ensure adherence of HVDC systems and components to local, national and international regulations relating to cross-border grids
Conduct safety checks to ensure all protocols are established and adhered to within system integration and operation activities
Perform risk assessments to identify potential hazards and threats to the operation of HVDC systems and interconnected grids

cwf.critical_work_function: Optimise High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) system performance, considering the suitability of innovations in technology
key_tasks: Monitor performance degradation of HDVC systems through predicted indicators
Monitor ongoing HVDC system operations and performance to identify patterns or trends to anticipate potential faults, load imbalances or stress to components
Design and integrate mitigation strategies to prevent degradation of HVDC systems and optimise performance
Conduct feasibility analyses across existing HVDC system infrastructures to consider suitability of integrating emerging systems and/or technology
Document potential integration plans for emerging systems and/or technology within existing HVDC systems
Collaborate with operation teams to ensure seamless integration of innovative technology and minimise impact on existing operations

description:
The Lead Engineer manages the end-to-end life-cycle of cross-border electricity import projects. He/She plans and executes projects, oversees multidisciplinary teams, and ensures compliance with technical, safety, and regulatory standards. He develops and validates High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) system designs, integrating advanced technologies while managing procurement, installation, and quality control. He leads commissioning efforts and implements performance optimisation and maintenance strategies to ensure efficient and reliable energy transmission systems.

Working collaboratively with teams across electricity import projects, the Lead Engineer possess skills in problem-solving, decision-making, and communication to manage technical challenges, engage with diverse stakeholders, and maintain transparency throughout the process.

cwf.critical_work_function: Drive stakeholder engagement and technical coordination
key_tasks: Serve as the main technical representative for regulators, contractors and international partners to align and manage expectations and address issues
Prepare technical reports and presentation and, translate data into actionable insights for internal and external stakeholders
Negotiate technical requirements, standards and compliance measures with cross-border stakeholders to streamline project implementation
Collaborate with government bodies and energy providers to ensure regulatory compliance and alignment with broader global and national energy policies
Facilitate technical knowledge-sharing sessions with stakeholders to foster transparency and informed decision-making during project execution

cwf.critical_work_function: Lead procurement, installation, and quality control
key_tasks: Define High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) equipment, buildings and infrastructure procurement requirements in line with technical and regulatory standards
Supervise the procurement process, evaluate vendor proposals for equipment quality, performance, and compatibility with project requirements
Oversee installation to ensure proper placement, alignment with designs and safety compliance
Conduct pre-commissioning inspection of High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) components to ensure quality, functionality and reliability
Address installation challenges by providing technical guidance to resolve issues while adhering to project timelines and scope
Supervise High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) system designs to meet Transmission Code and Singapore regulation
Validate High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) design specifications focusing on converter stations, submarine cables, and grid interface requirements
Coordinate with design teams to optimise layouts for system performance
Assess system compatibility with existing grid infrastructure, identify areas for efficiency improvements and explore solutions to ensure seamless integration
Approve design modifications for specific geographical, environmental or operational requirements while maintaining system performance

cwf.critical_work_function: Optimise system performance and ensure compliance
key_tasks: Develop testing protocols to assess system reliability, fault tolerance and thermal stability of High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) under simulated operational conditions
Oversee system updates, fix performance issues and ensure seamless integration with national energy infrastructure
Analyse performance data to identify inefficiencies and propose strategies to optimise system operation and reduce energy losses
Ensure and maintain updated regulatory documentation for audits and certifications to ensure compliance with local and international standards
Implement predictive maintenance models to minimise downtime and support long-term reliability of High Voltage Direct Current (HVDC) infrastructure components
Define objectives, phases, and resources for electricity import projects and ensure plans align with energy import policies and stakeholder goals
Develop project schedules that incorporates timelines, milestones, and resource allocations and ensure adherence to deliverables and budget constraints

Lead engineering teams in conducting feasibility studies, risk assessments and resource plans to support decision-making and minimise disruptions to projects while considering health, safety and the environment
Monitor and manage project risks and implement mitigation strategies to address potential delays, cost overruns and/or technical obstacles
Provide progress updates to stakeholders and ensure that project activities align with strategic and operational objectives

description:
The Technical Feasibility Engineer oversees electricity import projects by conducting technical and infrastructure feasibility assessments to ensure the viability and compatibility of electricity imports. He/She conducts risk assessments to identify operational, environmental and technical risks, and stays abreast of regulatory standards and requirements to ensure compliance. He provides recommendations on upgrades or adjustments to infrastructure, systems and operation protocols, and is responsible for the documentation and reporting to project stakeholders and decision-makers.

The Technical Feasibility Engineer requires good problem-solving and sense-making, skills to interpret complex data and make informed recommendations. He is apt at stakeholder management, effective in collaboration and communicates well to convey technical insights and feasibility outcomes to ensure clear alignment across teams.
performance_expectation: Submission requirements for Electricity Imports Proposals – Energy Market Authority

cwf.critical_work_function: Conduct technical and infrastructure feasibility assessments
key_tasks: Gather data related to existing electrical infrastructure to assess operational suitability for potential electricity imports
Identify technical and grid interconnection requirements to ensure compatibility and stability across interconnected power systems
Collaborate with project stakeholders to identify suitable technologies that support import infrastructure, considering grid requirements and potential integration challenges
Assess reliability metrics, energy flow and load factor data for integration planning insights
Utilise technical modelling to simulate flow and integration of imported electricity within existing systems

description: The Operations and Maintenance Engineer leads the operations and maintenance team in the operations, testing, monitoring, installation, troubleshooting and repair of electricity transmission or distribution equipment, auxiliaries, energy storage, control systems and substations. This includes implementing processes to integrate distributed generation sources with the grid, leading condition monitoring and preventive and predictive maintenance of equipment, and coordinating major cable diversion works to allow equipment and cable fault repair works to be carried out. He/She reviews recommended mitigating measures to prevent power disturbance events from happening. He also conducts the expansion of networks in the power quality monitoring system, and plans for the inspections of contractor activities carried out at worksites. He develops staff capabilities using appropriate capability development interventions and through on-the-job training. He monitors Permits-to-Work procedures, and interprets Safe System of Work (SSoW) frameworks and practices to his area of work. In times of emergency, he analyses the impact of emergency responses and relevant safety procedures on business operations, and facilitates the Emergency Response Teams activities on site incident management. He works in the control room, at substations or at cable sites and may be required to perform shift work. He is detail-oriented and systematic in enforcing maintenance procedures within the safety and operational guidelines. He possesses good leadership skills to lead team members and contractors.

description: The Operations and Maintenance Principal Engineer provides technical leadership in the operations and maintenance of electricity transmission or distribution equipment, auxiliaries, energy storage, control systems and substations, including planning for the integration of distributed generation sources with the grid, daily operations, condition monitoring and preventive and predictive maintenance of equipment. He/She also coordinates major cable diversion works to allow equipment and cable fault repair works to be carried out. He develops contract terms for, the hiring of contractors and vendors, and manages the related Permits-to-Work. He manages transmission and/or distribution power quality by overseeing implementation of mitigating measures for disturbance events, and evaluates risk assessment measures for works carried out. He also evaluates the severity of cyber incidents to determine the type of responses needed, and provides technical advisory in the implementation of vulnerability assessment and penetration testing. He leads technical capability development programmes, including on-the-job training and coaching, and formulates the technical training and development plans for the teams. He manages the Permits-to-Work for the team, and establishes Safe System of Work (SSoW) frameworks and practices for his area of work. He proposes emergency technical and recovery activities based on the crisis management framework, and determines the responses needed in emergency situations. To maintain high power quality, he oversees the implementation of mitigating measures to prevent future disturbance events from happening. He works in the control room, at substations or at cable sites and may be required to perform shift work. He has good leadership skills to direct team members and contractors. He is detail-oriented and systematic in planning maintenance procedures.

description: The Operations and Maintenance Senior Technical Officer supervises the operations, testing, monitoring, installation, troubleshooting and repair of electricity transmission or distribution equipment, auxiliaries, energy storage, control systems and substations. This includes condition monitoring, preventive and predictive maintenance of equipment, and major cable diversion works to allow equipment and cable fault repair works to be carried out. He/She recommends mitigating measures based on his review of disturbance event reports to prevent future occurrences from happening. He also manages the communication networks in the power quality monitoring system to ensure smooth transmission of information. He supervises teams in the implementation of cybersecurity frameworks and policies, cybersecurity incident response, and validates anomalous cyber activities and potential, threats detected. He performs on-the-job training when required and identifies appropriate training and development courses for staff to develop capabilities in the team. He issues work orders for Permits-to-Work, and supervises works according to Safe System of Work (SSoW) practices. In times of emergency, he implements emergency response plans and relevant safety procedures, and supervises the Emergency Response Team on site incident management. He works in the control room, at substations o rat cable sites, and may be required to perform shift work. He has good leadership skills to supervise team members and contractors. He is detail-oriented and systematic in enforcing maintenance procedures.

description: The Operations and Maintenance Technician supports the operations, testing, monitoring, installation, troubleshooting and repair of electricity transmission or distribution equipment, auxiliaries, energy storage, control systems and substations, including condition monitoring and preventive and predictive maintenance of equipment, conducting major cable diversion works to allow equipment and cable fault repair works to be carried out. He/She tracks disturbance events to support trending of power quality and reads sensor inputs to analyse equipment condition. He implements cybersecurity measures according to the frameworks and policies, detects anomalous activities and potential threats to network resources, and responds to cybersecurity incidents. He applies for Permits-to-Work for identified faults, and performs works according to Safe System of Work (SSoW) practices. In times of emergency, he responds as an Emergency Response Team member according to plans and relevant safety procedures. He inspects worksites and performs maintenance works at substations or at cable sites. He may also be required to perform shift work. He has good interpersonal skills and is a good team player in liaising with team members and contractors. He is detail-oriented and systematic in conducting maintenance procedures.

He is agile and calm in responding effectively to emergency situations, faults and outages.

description:
The Optimisation Engineer supports cross-functional clean energy areas and is responsible for maximising the efficiency, reliability, and performance of smart grid systems and battery energy storage technologies. He/She analyses system data to identify inefficiencies, designing and implementing optimisation strategies to enhance system performance. He also leads innovative initiatives to improve energy storage systems and the smart grid performance, working with research and development teams to develop and implement new technologies or software.

He possesses strong problem-solving skills, systems thinking, and data analysis proficiency. He must also be adept at innovation and collaboration, working effectively with stakeholders to achieve target outcomes.

cwf.critical_work_function: Analyse system performance for smart grid systems and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)
key_tasks: Collect operational data from smart grid and BESS components to identify inefficiencies
Perform trend analysis with data on energy flow to detect irregularities and utilise appropriate programming code to assess their impact on system efficiency and reliability
Conduct root-cause analysis on identified performance issues and pinpoint system bottlenecks that may guide optimisation efforts
Develop performance metrics to evaluate existing operational processes that focuses on load management and energy storage dynamics of smart grid systems and BESS
Analyse impact of environmental and operational factors on smart grid and BESS stability, utilise appropriate programming codes to derive data-driven insights for optimisation strategies

cwf.critical_work_function: Design optimisation strategies for smart grid systems and Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS)
key_tasks: Design algorithms to enhance the coordination between distributed energy resources (DERs) to optimise energy flow and improve grid stability for smart grid systems and BESS
Develop strategies to enhance the efficiency, reliability and cost-effectiveness of smart grid systems and BESS while ensuring alignment with operational goals and regulatory standards
Develop technical designs for optimisation engines and ensure seamless integration with smart grid and BESS infrastructure to enhance system performance and scalability
Design optimisation algorithms to reduce energy losses and enhance storage utilisation as well as balance supply and demand of smart grid systems and BESS

description:
The Power System Engineer supports cross-functional clean energy areas and designs and optimises power systems, integrating Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), solar energy technologies, and smart grid solutions into existing and future electricity networks. He/She develops system architectures, simulates performance, and optimises control strategies for the generation, transmission and distribution of clean energy sources. He implements and manages energy flow, and monitors system performance to ensure the reliable and efficient operations of power systems that incorporate renewable energies. 

 

The Power System Engineer requires collaboration and problem-solving skills to work effectively across teams, exercises creative thinking and sense-making to develop innovative solutions, and should have digital fluency and learning agility to adapt to new technologies.

cwf.critical_work_function: Analyse and enhance power system performance
key_tasks: Assess energy losses and inefficiencies in storage and discharge cycles and implement improvements to reduce downtime and maximise energy retention
Perform analyses of power systems behaviour under varying load conditions and identify areas for optimising long-term performance
Refine power management strategies to meet fluctuating supply and demand to ensure that renewable energy systems, energy storage and electricity imports respond dynamically to grid requirements
Report system performance trends and provide actionable insights and recommendations for further enhancements and future upgrades
Simulate system performance under various operating conditions to predict potential issues, mitigate risks to ensure consistent energy storage and grid integration

cwf.critical_work_function: Conduct technical assessments and continuous system optimisation
key_tasks: Evaluate the performance of renewable energy systems, ESS, electricity imports, and smart grids through technical assessments to ensure alignment with safety standards, grid regulations and performance benchmarks
Develop comprehensive models  to simulate system behaviour under stress conditions and test system robustness  bthrough identification of potential bottlenecks or failures
Analyse efficiency metrics for renewable energy systems, BESS, electricity imports and smart grids to refine architectures, enhance performance and optimise energy utilisation
Implement energy efficiency and conservation measures by assessing power consumption patterns and optimise system configurations
Implement predictive maintenance strategies  with diagnostic tools to anticipate system issues  and ensure consistent and efficient operation
Collaborate with technical teams to fine-tune system parameters based on ongoing assessments and continuously drive improvements in efficiency and reliability

cwf.critical_work_function: Design, plan and optimise power systems
key_tasks: Design scalable, adaptable and efficient power systems for storing clean energy to meet current and projected energy demand and ensure integration with diverse grid applications and optimising energy distribution
Develop power system architectures that support both battery energy storage systems and grid interaction to enable seamless control and load management
Simulate the performance of power systems including renewable energy sources, energy storage, and grid interactions, under various environmental and load conditions to inform system design choices
Conduct load flow studies, voltage stability analyses and system modelling to assess the electric grid’s capacity for integrating clean energy sources efficiently

Optimise the interaction between renewable energy systems, energy storage, electricity imports and grid components to ensure efficient power flow, reduced energy losses and enhanced system reliability
Define project-specific technical requirements and collaborate with stakeholders to ensure designs meet regulatory and operational specifications
Determine optimal configurations of renewable energy systems and grid components by evaluating factors related to load variability, energy losses, environmental conditions and regulatory constraints

cwf.critical_work_function: Develop control strategies and power management
key_tasks: Design control systems that regulate energy flow between battery energy storage systems (BESS), grid systems and power generation components to ensure efficient energy transfer
Design and implement protection systems to safeguard renewable energy systems, BESS, grid components and electricity imports against faults, overloads and external disruptions
Implement real-time control strategies to balance renewable generation, ESS, electricity imports, and grid interactions to optimise performance across energy systems
Develop software-based control systems that automate key power management functions and reduce human intervention and improving system responsiveness
Conduct simulations to validate control system designs to ensure that desired energy flow and control targets are achieved under diverse operating conditions
Improve control strategies iteratively by integrating machine learning and analytics for predictive maintenance and system optimisation

description: The Engineering and Maintenance Engineer supervises the asset management team in carrying out preventive and corrective maintenance of the plant equipment. He/She performs predictive maintenance and reliability-centred maintenance works, implements plant improvement projects and reviews plant incidents and responses. In a bid to protect the plant against cyberthreats, he carries out cybersecurity operations in monitoring, preparing and responding to incidents. He develops staff capabilities using appropriate capability development interventions and through on-the-job training. He monitors the execution of Permits-to-Work procedures, and implements Safe System of Work (SSoW) frameworks and practices to his area of work. In times of emergency, he analyses the impact of emergency responses and relevant safety procedures on business operations. He also facilitates the Emergency Response Teams activities on site incident management. He works in the administration office of the power plant, which is typically situated in the industrial areas of Singapore. He also deals with the equipment in the power plant station equipment, such as generators, motors, turbines, high pressure vessels, boiler, condensers and compressors. He is detail-oriented and systematic in conducting maintenance procedures and has good communication skills to collaborate with his team. In addition, he is agile and quick-witted in responding effectively to faults and outages. Furthermore, he is intellectually curious in identifying ways to improve the plants' preparedness against cyberthreats.

description: The Engineering and Maintenance Manager oversees the asset management team in carrying out predictive, preventive and corrective maintenance of the plant equipment to ensure that power is generated reliably in the plant. He/She reviews work carried out by the team, and contractors, as well as establishes follow-up actions to be taken. He conducts the planning of asset management and reliability centred maintenance to improve efficiency in maintenance. In a bid to protect the plant against cyberthreats, he develops and formulates the cybersecurity framework, procedures and guidelines. He coaches the team according to their strengths and areas of development to help them achieve performance targets. He reviews overall training and development plans for the department to ensure that they are aligned with organisational plans. He manages overall Safe System of Work (SSoW) practices according to statutory requirements and best industrial practices. He collaborates with the crisis management team on emergency situations and recovery activities, and leads emergency responses as a Site Incident Controller. He works in the administration office of the power plant, which is typically situated in the industrial areas of Singapore. He also deals with the equipment in the power plant station, such as generators, motors, turbines, high pressure vessels, boiler, condensers and compressors. He possesses good leadership skills to lead junior team members and contractors. He is detail-oriented and systematic in developing plans for the department. In addition, he is agile and quick-witted in adapting to emergency situations. Furthermore, he is innovative in finding ways to improve the plants' preparedness against cyberthreats. He demonstrates good networking skills to collaborate with authorities and other stakeholders for Statutory Inspections and other requirements.

description: The Multi-Utility, Operations and Water Quality Control Department Manager oversees the power plant operations to ensure that adequate fuel is supplied to generate electricity to meet production targets. He/She engages the, industry on best practices and implement them to streamline and improve processes and operational management. He also monitors maintenance works for the plant, multi-utility and water quality control facilities. He manages compliance issues by conducting reviews on work processes, establishes the department's work plan and capital and operational expenditure budgets. He also conducts strategic manpower planning for the department. He establishes innovative safe work practices based on industry best practices, and defines policies and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for Permit-To-Work system. He formulates emergency response strategies, plans and procedures. In times of emergency, he oversee emergency responses as a Site Main Controller. He works in the administration office of the power plant, which is typically situated in the industrial areas of Singapore. He may also occasionally deal with the equipment in the power plant station, such as generators, motors, turbines, and high pressure vessels. He possesses good leadership skills in leading the operations team and is innovative in adopting industry best practices for the department.
performance_expectation: In accordance with: Work at Height Certification, Confined Space Supervisor Certification

He possesses good communication, people management and problem solving skills in leading the water quality control team.

description:
The Edge Connectivity and Solution Engineer designs, implements, and maintains end-to-end edge connectivity solutions for clean energy systems. He/She collects, integrates, and transforms industrial data for cloud use, while ensuring its accuracy and reliability. He also optimises data flow through secure pipelines, enhances grid performance with edge computing solutions, and ensures system security and compliance with industry standards. He addresses site-specific connectivity issues and implements edge computing architectures to improve system responsiveness, intelligence, and overall efficiency.

The Edge Connectivity and Solution Engineer possesses communication skills to collaborate across teams, creative thinking for innovative solutions, and problem-solving to address connectivity issues. Learning agility and sense-making are essential to adapt to new technologies and optimise system performance efficiently, alongside power and clean energy domain knowledge.

cwf.critical_work_function: Design and implement edge computing solutions
key_tasks: Integrate advanced data analytics and machine learning to continuously optimise edge computing solutions, enable predictive maintenance, fault detection and improved operational efficiency in smart grid systems
Enhance the responsiveness of smart grid systems by reducing dependence on centralised cloud processing through local edge decision-making capabilities
Design innovative edge computing solutions that enhance the efficiency, responsiveness and intelligence of smart grid systems
Implement edge computing architectures that reduce latency, optimise data processing and enable real-time decision-making at the grid edge
Develop algorithms and software for edge computing devices and ensure that data is processed locally for faster response times and reduced reliance on cloud servers
Develop networking architectures for smart grid edge devices to ensure scalability, low-latency communication and seamless integration with cloud platforms
Develop configurations for edge devices to ensure reliable connections and secure data transmission between on-site equipment and cloud systems
Establish and select appropriate communication protocols to ensure smooth data transmission to the cloud for monitoring and analysis
Create network optimisation strategies to enhance system efficiency and handle various data loads
Plan and design connectivity infrastructure solutions to meet both current and future operational needs by collaborating with multidisciplinary teams
Design scalable and modular edge connectivity infrastructure and ensure seamless integration with cloud platforms and support future expansions
Develop blueprints for edge device deployment by considering geographic distribution factors, network topology and latency requirements

cwf.critical_work_function: Ensure system security and compliance for edge systems
key_tasks: Develop robust security protocols to safeguard edge devices and their communication paths to reduce risk of cyberattacks and unauthorised data access
Design robust security architectures including encryption, firewalls and access control systems to ensure data integrity and secure edge-to-cloud communication
Monitor compliance with industry standards to ensure security and functionality across all edge connectivity systems
Perform security audits and system tests to identify vulnerabilities in edge-to-cloud data flow and make recommendations to enhance system resilience
Implement encryption, Virtual Private Network (VPN), and other security measures to ensure safe transmission of data between edge devices and cloud platforms
Respond to security incidents by diagnosing root causes and take corrective actions to prevent future threats
Set up end-to-end connectivity solutions, linking smart grid devices to cloud-based platforms to ensure smooth data flow and minimal latency
Install and configure communication devices at distributed edge locations and validate connectivity from devices to cloud storage systems
Deploy edge gateways and facilitate the transformation of industrial data into compatible formats for cloud integration to ensure seamless data aggregation
Perform initial data validation during infrastructure setup by analysing data flow and identify discrepancies to ensure accurate reporting and analysis in cloud systems
Identify site-specific connectivity issues by analysing data flow and investigate potential bottlenecks or failures at the edge
Develop and implement corrective action plans by adjusting system configurations and replace faulty components to optimise network performance
Conduct regular maintenance checks on communication devices, edge gateways and network configurations to ensure system health and performance consistency
Develop troubleshooting protocols for field teams to guide the resolution of common connectivity issues at distributed edge locations
Oversee data collection, integration and transformation processes related to edge-to-cloud data integration and ensure that industrial data is accurately transferred and formatted for cloud use
Implement data pipelines that ensure real-time and batch data from edge devices is securely transmitted, processed and accessible in cloud environments
Optimise edge-to-cloud data pathways through continuous data analysis and system monitoring, improve data efficiency while minimising latency and storage costs
Maintain data synchronisation across edge computing nodes and cloud platforms and ensure accurate and real-time data availability for grid operations
Continuously monitor and validate the accuracy of data through automated and manual checks to ensure real-time reliability and consistency in grid operations
