description: The Town Gas Plant Maintenance Manager oversees the town gas plant maintenance processes. He/She manages the manpower, including the hiring of contractors, to execute the preventive, predictive and corrective maintenance schedule of gas production plants and ancillaries to ensure that town gas is stored and produced efficiently in the plant. He builds staff capability by motivating staff to maximise their work potential and manages the strengths and development areas of the teams. To protect the plant against cyberthreats, he develops and formulates the cybersecurity frameworks, procedures and guidelines. He manages the overall Safe System of Work (SSoW) practices according to statutory requirements and best industry practices. He collaborates with the crisis management team on emergency situations and recovery activities, and leads emergency responses as a Site Incident Controller. He works in the gas plant facility containing equipment such as pumps, tanks and valves, where there is high focus on safety. He has good leadership skills to manage junior team members and contractors. He is strategic and systematic in planning and managing maintenance procedures. He is responsible and swift in adapting to emergency situations, faults and outages.

key_tasks: Manage overall Safe System of Work (SSoW) practices according to statutory requirements and best industry practices
Lead continuous improvement projects to improve safety in the workplace
Manage contractors on safe work practices to ensure compliance with statutory requirements and procedures
Revise Permit-To-Work procedures and frameworks based on updates on safety standards by Ministry of Manpower
Review overall training and development plans for the team according to organisational plans
Lead communication and sharing sessions with the staff to gather feedback and disseminate relevant information
Coach team according to their strengths and areas of development to help them achieve performance targets
Manage the forecasting, preparation, monitoring and control of operating and capital expenditure budgets
Manage works done by contractors
Approve technical and project specifications for tenders
Select contractors to award for projects
Design the data model for the federated view of cyber threat information in the cyber threat detection systems
Manage cybersecurity incident responses in the team
Organise vulnerability assessments and penetration testings on the operation systems
Plan cybersecurity risk management exercises and audits
Organise the contents of security operation management and statistical reports for submission
Review implementation of mitigation measures to ensure vulnerabilities are eliminated
Develop cybersecurity frameworks, policies, processes, procedures and guidelines
Deploy recovery and remediation measures to minimise disruption by cyber attacks

description: The Town Gas Production Manager oversees the operation of the town gas production plants and drives the operational strategies to optimise operational effectiveness. He/She manages the cost and quality requirements in the plant integrity management processes, and drives the strategies for managing faults and breakdowns in the plant. He develops staff capabilities by motivating them to maximise their work potential and managing the strengths and developmental areas of the teams. He directs work according to Safe System of Work (SSoW) procedures and risk control measures to ensure work activities are carried out safely. He collaborates with the crisis management team on emergency situations and recovery activities. He works in a safety-oriented environment at the town gas production plant facility. He has good leadership skills to lead junior team members and contractors. He is strategic and systematic in planning and managing operational procedures. He is responsible and swift in adapting to emergency situations, faults and outages.

description: The Town Gas Production Senior Technical Officer supervises the end-to-end town gas production. He/She implements and observes the proper and efficient operations of the gas production plants and ancillaries. He oversees the troubleshooting of faults and breakdowns in the gas production plants, and develops staff capabilities through on-the-job training. He issues work orders for Permits-to-Work, and supervises works according to Safe System of Work (SSoW) practices. He has good interpersonal skills to be able to supervise junior team members and contractors, and coordinate with the maintenance team. He is meticulous and systematic in performing operational procedures. He is agile and calm in responding effectively to faults and outages.

description: The Installation, Inspection and Servicing Engineer plans for inspections of gas installations, reviews gas investigation findings and relevant documentation, and recommends servicing and/or rectification works required for gas installation issues. He/She oversees gas installation, and servicing works, and the commissioning of gas appliances. He manages the submissions of billings and meter statements, and reviews the technical specifications prepared for tender contracts. He/She oversees works performed by Licensed Gas Service Workers (LGSWs) to ensure compliance with Codes of Practice, regulatory and project requirements, and manages customers' feedback and requests for the installation, replacement and troubleshooting of gas appliances. To build internal capabilities,, he provides on-the-job training and analyses staffs strengths and areas of development. He supervises gas pipe works at customers' sites, including domestic, commercial and industrial buildings, and is therefore required to have a high awareness of safety. He is analytical, systematic and communicative in performing the gas technical services. He is a good team leader and collaborates effectively with key stakeholders.
performance_expectation: In accordance with: Gas Service Worker License (Restricted)
